prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: original fashion lookbook contact sheet for an independent, speculative FILA 2027 study. This is concept art, not an official collection, historical photograph, or real product inventory.

Primary request: create one polished editorial studio fashion photography contact sheet with EXACTLY four equal-width columns and two equal-height rows, a precise 4 by 2 grid containing exactly eight standing adult figures. Top row: full FRONT views of four complete outfits, left to right looks 09, 10, 11, 12. Bottom row: matching full BACK views of the SAME four outfits and SAME models in the same left-to-right order. No extra figures. Each model is fully inside its own cell with generous equal margins, whole head and all toes fully visible. Each figure is isolated against the same seamless warm ivory studio backdrop. Do not draw visible grid lines or frames. Landscape canvas, approximately 4:3 aspect ratio. Exact orderly spacing and alignment; every cell usable as an independent crop.

Capsule theme: Coast. A coherent original modern athletic-luxury capsule combining heritage tennis function, restrained modular rectangular seam geometry inspired by midcentury design, premium understatement, and Southern California ocean color mood. Deep teal, soft seafoam, warm cream/ivory, a little thin navy edging. Tactile real-looking fabric, sophisticated fit, complete outfits including unbranded simple tennis shoes.

Column 1 / look 09: adult East Asian female model. Seafoam rib-knit short-sleeve zip polo with a subtle cream zipper and thin navy edging on collar and cuff, ivory high-waisted tailored tennis shorts with relaxed pleated front and functional side pockets, ivory low-top tennis shoes. Back view shows continuous rib-knit polo texture, clean back of shorts, matched sleeve and collar edges.
Column 2 / look 10: adult Black male model. Deep teal lightweight matte field/court jacket with elegant cream rectangular seam bands on shoulders and panels, a restrained center zipper, seafoam relaxed cropped straight trousers, ivory low-top tennis shoes. Back view shows matched rectangular shoulder/back seams, no added graphics.
Column 3 / look 11: adult South Asian female model. Ivory sleeveless cotton tennis top with a deep teal geometric rectangular shoulder panel, deep teal high-waisted wide pleated trousers, simple ivory low-top tennis shoes. Back view carries the same geometric shoulder language and complete wide trouser silhouette.
Column 4 / look 12: adult white female model with short brown hair. Deep teal minimal sleeveless longline zip dress, refined straight relaxed silhouette ending mid-calf with movement vent, seafoam rectangular hem panel, simple ivory tennis shoes. Matching back view shows a clear straight rear silhouette and the seafoam rectangular hem panel with modest center-back movement vent.

Style/medium: highly polished original premium fashion editorial studio photographs, realistic invented adult models, neutral standing poses, quiet poised expressions. Soft even diffuse studio lighting, precise fabric grain, visible rib knit, cotton texture, lightweight matte jacket fabric, subtle natural shadows under shoes. Front figures facing directly toward camera; back figures facing completely away from camera. Consistent scale of models and camera. No props or scenery.

Constraints: EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS and TWO ROWS; exactly eight fully visible separate adult figures; matching front/back garments; clean ivory background; no words, letters, numbers, logos, trademarks, monograms, watermarks, printed graphics, or branding anywhere on clothing or image. No official FILA logo. No real athletes or celebrities. No palm-print stereotypes. No Nouns graphics. No cropped heads, cropped feet, overlapping cells, extra clothing, perspective layouts, collage overlap, or contact-sheet labels.
